messages:
sam: FYI noticed a weird regression after rolling quantized reranker-v3 to staging: ndcg@10 ~unchanged but MRR@10 drops ~5% for queries that include urls or version-like tokens (e.g., "v2", "v2.1"). starting a thread to capture triage.

nora: can you paste the slice def and the exact numbers? is this across candidate pools or one dataset?

sam: slice = queries with regex match r'(https?://|\bv\d(\.\d)?\b)' and query_len <= 12. dataset = prod_holdout_2026_02.jsonl. quick numbers: float32 -> quant8
- ndcg@10: 0.701 -> 0.698
- mrr@10: 0.482 -> 0.457 (delta -5.2%)

anya: hmm odd. punctuation and numeric tokens often hit different subword splits. quant noise could be amplifying small embedding differences that affect top1. do we have tokenization diffs between float and quant runs?

sam: ran a token diff script for some flips. examples:
- qid 4102: "upgrade to v2.1 for api"
  float tokens: ["upgrade","to","v","2",".","1","for","api"]
  quant tokens: ["upgrade","to","v2",".1","for","api"]
- qid 4120: "see https://example.com/docs#v2"
  float tokens: ["see","http","s","://","example",".","com","/","docs","#","v","2"]
  quant tokens: ["see","https://example.com/docs#v2"]

nora: whoa, quant tokenization differences? that shouldn't happen unless preprocessing changed. are we sure the eval runner used the same tokenizer binary and version? also clipped/quant kernel shouldn't affect tokenization stage.

sam: confirmed tokenizer binary is the same container image tag, but I noticed the quant pipeline sets `preproc.normalize_urls=true` for normalization micro-optimizations. float run used normalize_urls=false historically. looks like the config drift caused different query inputs, not the model itself.

anya: aha. so the root cause may be input-side normalization divergence introduced accidentally in the quant packaging. that would explain stable ndcg (broad ranking preserved) but MRR falls if top1 flipping occurs due to token boundary changes.

nora: good catch. two immediate actions: 1) re-run quant eval with normalize_urls=false to isolate model-only impact, 2) add a preflight check ensuring tokenizer flags are identical between floats/quant artifacts. can you queue the job?

sam: queued job 5270000001 (quant-run with normalize_urls=false). eval-bot: job submitted.

eval-bot: Job submitted: 5270000001. Logs + outputs will be under /runs/5270000001/* once complete.

anya: longer-term: add explicit deterministic tokenization manifest to the model bundle (tokenizer_hash, preproc_flags) and surface it in the model catalog UI so reviewers can catch drift. also add a small URL/version prime set (2k queries) to the quant smoke that checks mrr delta < 1%.

nora: agree. I'll open the catalog manifest PR and the quant-checklist change. also add a lint that fails packaging if preproc flags differ from the float baseline.

sam: posting follow-ups here after job finishes. thanks all.
